purpose: Primary-source evidence for docs/battery_microstructure_review.md; not a performance calibration dataset.

sources.title: Effect of Calendering on Electrode Wettability in Lithium-Ion Batteries
sources.verified_scope: Original full article: methods, wetting results and cavity/passage discussion
sources.supported_mechanism: Calendering/wetting relation need not be monotone; pore arrangement matters
sources.transfer_limit: Do not transfer the optimum or absolute rates to our recipe

sources.title: Quantifying microstructural dynamics and electrochemical activity of graphite and silicon-graphite lithium ion battery anodes
sources.type: operando experimental study with numerical diffusion calculations
sources.verified_scope: Original full text: volume correlation, alignment/deformation and tortuosity methods/results
sources.supported_mechanism: Plate alignment relates to anisotropy; Si-containing microstructure deforms locally during operation
sources.transfer_limit: Our fresh 2-D images do not provide the 3-D/dynamic measurements

sources.title: Unravelling electro-chemo-mechanical processes in graphite/silicon composites for designing nanoporous and microstructured battery electrodes
sources.type: multimodal operando imaging and electrochemical experiments
sources.material: Graphite/microporous Si and graphite/SiOx, including a commercial electrode
sources.verified_scope: Original full text: Fig. 4 particle-contact/enclosure and reaction-order discussion; Fig. 5 pore/CBD strain discussion; conclusions
sources.supported_mechanism: Local contact and electrolyte enclosure can compete; reaction order is not determined by size alone
sources.transfer_limit: No literature contact-range or cycling threshold becomes a QC limit here

sources.title: Chemical staining for fundamental studies and optimization of binders in Li-ion battery negative electrodes
sources.type: original binder-mapping, electrical/ionic and manufacturing experiments
sources.material: Common aqueous binder systems in graphite and Si-containing negative electrodes
sources.verified_scope: Original full text: ordinary-SEM identification limits, slurry/CBD agglomeration, drying/adhesion and staining limitations
sources.supported_mechanism: Mixing and drying redistribute binder/carbon domains; ordinary contrast does not identify common binders
sources.transfer_limit: Specialist staining is external validation, not assumed available data or an action here

sources.title: Li-ion Electrode Microstructure Evolution during Drying and Calendering
sources.type: original SEM/EDX and electronic/ionic resistance experiments
sources.verified_scope: Original publisher-indexed text: experimental design, cross-section preparation and transport/contact-resistance results; direct page retrieval failed
sources.supported_mechanism: Drying changes component distributions and transport/contact resistance; calendering effects depend on history
sources.transfer_limit: PVDF recipe and process optima are not product specifications

sources.title: Tortuosity Anisotropy in Lithium-Ion Battery Electrodes
sources.verified_scope: Original publisher abstract only; attempted institutional PDF returned 404
sources.supported_mechanism: Particle shape and fabrication alignment relate to directional tortuosity
sources.transfer_limit: No detailed quantitative prediction or model parameter adopted from unread full text

sources.title: Size-dependent fracture of silicon nanoparticles during lithiation
sources.verified_scope: Original research abstract verified; publisher full text not retrieved
sources.supported_mechanism: Size-dependent first-lithiation fracture in the studied Si nanoparticles
sources.transfer_limit: No universal fracture cutoff for SiOx/composite microparticles

sources.title: CROSS SECTION POLISHER: principles of processing
sources.verified_scope: Differential milling-rate and beam-direction streak explanation
sources.supported_mechanism: Mixed-material milling can create directional surface roughness
sources.transfer_limit: Does not establish that every observed directional feature is an artefact

sources.title: IB-19520CCP cooling examples
sources.material: Galvanized steel and bonded Si examples
sources.verified_scope: Normal/cooled preparation changes interface voids and bonding-agent morphology
sources.supported_mechanism: Preparation temperature is an alternative explanation to investigate
sources.transfer_limit: Non-electrode examples do not prove our electrode voids are preparation damage

sources.title: Geometric identities in stereological particle analysis
sources.verified_scope: Overview, report page 2 / PDF page 4: volume represented by integrated areas of horizontal sections; stochastic interpretation and distinction from the individual-particle problem
sources.supported_mechanism: Representative section-volume sampling is distinct from isotropic particle orientation
sources.transfer_limit: Fixed convenient section locations can be unrepresentative; irregular reference domains need proper weighting; no calibrated volume fraction adopted

sources.title: Comparison of three-dimensional analysis and stereological techniques for quantifying lithium-ion battery electrode microstructures
sources.material: Commercial graphite, LCO and LMO electrodes
sources.verified_scope: Original full text: pore-volume results and Table 3, geometric tortuosity results, 2-D/3-D connectivity discussion
sources.supported_mechanism: Complete slice means match volumetric fractions across axes while individual sections vary; 2-D disconnection does not establish 3-D disconnection
sources.transfer_limit: Does not prove our selected sections representative or calibrate segmentation
